subject.title: [Security] Session hijacking vulnerability due to predictable sequence IDs in gateway client

question: Does the gateway security owner confirm that event `seq` values are ordering metadata only and cannot affect authentication, authorization, session selection, request correlation, or RPC dispatch?
rationale: Source and documented contracts contradict the reported exploit theory, but protected security handling requires an explicit owner disposition before closure.

options.title: Close as non-vulnerability
options.body: Confirm the existing authenticated-connection boundary and close because guessing event ordering metadata grants no authority.
